exposure: parallel transverse uterine incision (PTUI) cesarean section (CS)
prophylactic internal iliac artery (IIA) balloon occlusion (BO)
outcome: pre- and postoperative serum hemoglobin and hematocrit
cohort: 64 women diagnosed with pernicious placenta previa (PPP) and placenta accreta (PA) who underwent parallel transverse uterine incision (PTUI) cesarean section (CS)
finding: Prophylactic internal iliac artery balloon occlusion (IIA BO) during PTUI CS in women with PPP and PA does not lead to a statistically significant reduction in EBL.
